definitions.explanation: Having a disposition that is easily affected by small things or prone to worry.
Being overly concerned about details or small matters.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{神経質|しんけいしつ}で、{小|ちい}さなことでも{気|き}にする。
examples.english: He's nervous and worries about even small things.

examples.japanese: {神経質|しんけいしつ}になりすぎないでください。
examples.english: Please don't be too high-strung about it.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{清潔|せいけつ}さについて{神経質|しんけいしつ}だ。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{神経|しんけい} (nerves) + {質|しつ} (nature, quality)

USAGE:
Can be used neutrally to describe someone sensitive, or negatively to suggest someone is overly anxious or fussy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{神経質|しんけいしつ}な{人|ひと} - a nervous/sensitive person
・{神経質|しんけいしつ}になる - to become nervous/fussy
・〜について{神経質|しんけいしつ}だ - to be particular about ~

RELATED:
・{繊細|せんさい} - delicate, sensitive (often positive)
・{臆病|おくびょう} - timid, cowardly
・{心配性|しんぱいしょう} - worrywart
・ナーバス - nervous (loanword)
